Results.ReviewText: This is a very nice looking and easy to use grill.  It works as it should and cooks the food evenly.  I would highly recommend this to anyone.
Results.Title: Fantastic Grill

Results.ReviewText:
Quality built compared to the others as you can tell when you look at them. Easy to use and most important clean. Grease removal system is great, I’ve had no flare ups so far.
Very expensive but seems worth it so far.
Results.Title: Excellent grill

Results.ReviewText: I made my purchase a month ago and am very happy with it. It is easy to move around on it's 4 wheels. Starts every time with one push of the ignitor button. Quality product.
Results.Title: Great product

Results.ReviewText: I purchased this grill at Home Depot in May.  It was very easy to put together, since the instructions were well written.  I always wanted a Weber grill and finally decided to spring for the expense.  What sold me on the E-210 was it quality and the fact that it was the only Weber grill I found with fold down side supports for accessories and plates.  Weber needs to rethink its decision to not include the fold down feature on its other grills.  I have used the grill twice and find that it heats ups quickly and is able to maintain the temperature I set unlike previous grills I have owned. I highly recommend the Weber Spirit E-210 propane grill.
Results.Title: Excellent Grill

Results.ReviewText: I bought the enclosed model rather than the cart style due to looks and the four sided enclosed tank compartment. Works well so far decided to buy a Weber after years of using basic big box stores cheaper quality grills. Had the features I was looking for for  use on a wooden deck condo in Michigan. Seems to be sturdy and fires up and heats up quickly. Remember its a grill not a BBQ or smoker. Good for quick things steaks chops brats Tri-tip etc.Had to order it from a local hardware store none in stock only cart style plus it was 50 bucks more for the cabinet style . Maybe my last grill time will tell. Cover fits ok that was extra 60 bucks no better than a generic style.Worth a look if its in your price point.
Results.Title: Good Quality

Results.ReviewText: My Spirit E-210 was purchased to replace an old Genesis that died.  Things I like: 1. Heats quickly and burns efficient - it doesn't use much gas to keep the temperature up.  2. Controls on the front, leaving the right side surface free for use.  Things I miss or don't like about the Spirit: 1. Tank mounts inside the cabinet, which makes it harder to mount. 2. No second swinging upper warming rack, even though are mounts for one inside the cover where one could hang. 3. No tray for holding things like marinade bottles or packaging when you are putting meat  on the grill.
Results.Title: Mixed feelings about my new Weber Grill

Results.ReviewText: Bought this grill for Father's Day gift! So far I'm very pleased with it. And am hoping it lasts as long as my previous grill, which I had for 37 yrs.
Results.Title: Exceptional Quality!

Results.ReviewText: I replaced my old Charbroil grill with a smaller Weber grill. The grill is well designed was was easy to put together. The grill cooks much better to temperature than the old one and I am happy with my purchase.
Results.Title: Good value for the money and well built

Results.ReviewText: My First Weber did not disappoint everything I wanted
Results.Title: My first Weber

Results.ReviewText: Looks good, size is great because it’s deeper and narrower. We don’t need to feed the neighborhood. Easy to cook on, no hot spots. Very happy
Results.Title: Love the size

Results.ReviewText: Small enough not to swamp the balcony, but both powerful & flexible enough to whip up all kinds of great dinners + lunches. The gas scale that lets you know when the tank is running low is also a great touch.
Results.Title: Superb apartment balcony grill

Results.ReviewText: I bought this after doing research for a year or two. Best decision I could have made for a grill. Love the ease of use and the super quick cooking ability of this grill. So glad I decided on this Weber Grill!!!
Results.Title: Great features, easy to use!

Results.ReviewText: We bought our grill a month ago and have enjoyed using it  for slow cooking barbecue as well as steaks and burgers.  There is minimal gas taste and it cooks evenly.  I really like the tank gauge although it binds a bit and is ambivalent on the low end of the gas.  All in allo, it seems to be one of the best grilles we ever purchased.  I am impressed with the quality.
Results.Title: Good Product

Results.ReviewText: This is the best grill I have ever purchased. Very nice product
Results.Title: Very nice grill

Results.ReviewText: I recently traded in my Weber E-310 that I purchased in 2010 for the smaller Weber E-210.  Assembly was easy enough and I was very pleased that the side tables can be folded down.  I don't have a large patio so I appreciate my grill not hogging up the whole deck.
Results.Title: Perfect for My Patio

Results.ReviewText: My old Weber Silver Genesis finally bit the dust after 19 years of good service, so it was time to get a new grill.  My wife and I no longer need a big grill, so the Spirit E-210 is just the right size for the two of us.  So far it works just as I expected.
Results.Title: Nice little grill

Results.ReviewText: I've had many grills. Weber is the best out there. I had my first Weber for almost 15 years.
Results.Title: Best

Results.ReviewText: only have the grill a short time works great .I can really appreciate the value over my previous grill.

Results.ReviewText: I am impressed with the equal heat distribution throughout the whole grilling surface.
Results.Title: Very happy!

Results.Title: Perfect size, great features

Results.ReviewText: My son bought this for me. After a few weeks of using, I’m happy. Lights instantly, hotter than my old grill. So far , so good.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Love it! Perfect size for two and enough for family gatherings. Excellent quality. Can’t beat 10 year warrantee! Have been using it almost every day since we bought it.

Results.Title: Durability

Results.ReviewText:
I bought this to replace a Kenmore grill I had for 14 yrs. The kids are gone so we decided on a smaller grill.
Weber has a great reputation so we went with the Spirit E-210.
I must say, I am pretty disappointed. It doesn't get hot enough to sear a steak. I have to cook with the cover closed if I want any sort of heat.
Right now, for example, I have had my cast iron pan on the grill on high for about 20 minutes with bacon in the pan. The bacon isn't cooking. The fat isn't even begun to melt.
If I hadn't had this for as long as I have, a month or so, I'd return it.
Results.Title: Meh

Results.ReviewText: I have been very happy with my weber spirit E-210.  It heats up very fast and can maintain temps with ease.

Results.ReviewText: casters make it very difficult to move grill on to grass . casters get bogged down & grill almost tips over !

Results.ReviewText: Since buying this I’ve used it more times than my old grill I had for years. Easy to use, cleans up quickly and takes up very little space.
Results.Title: Love this!

Results.ReviewText: We purchased the grill about 6 weeks ago, put it together in slightly over 2 hours and felt the picture directions  were pretty easy to follow. Starts on the first attempt and heats up quickly. The side tables tuck away nicely. Really do like it!
Results.Title: Love our new grill!

Results.ReviewText: After looking as a wide range of stoves I found the weber to be a head above the rest.  I like the folding side table, wheels on all four legs, the enclosed area for the propane tank.  I didn't like the spirit II.  The hood was lighter and the propane exposed as well as moving with just 2 roller wheels was not as convenient.
Results.Title: great construction and features

Results.ReviewText: I purchased the Spirit E-210 as my first Weber Grill ever.  I am so glad that I did.  It is the best grill I have ever used.  On top of that, when I purchased it at Home Depot, the first time I used it I noticed that part of the grilling service was chipped off.  I wrote Weber and they replaced the whole grate with overnight shipping.  Top Notch.. I'm Weber for live!!!  Spend the few extra bucks and get one.  You will not be disappointed.
Results.Title: Customer service is top notch

Results.ReviewText: I only wanted a two burner gas grill so the Spirit E-210 fit the bill, nice and compact. It has 4 wheels which makes it easy to maneuver. I like that the propane tank is hidden below out of sight.  An added bonus is the gauge that lets you know when the fuel is getting low.  You can also use the direct and indirect method for cooking.  It is built well so it will last a long time, which is good since I use mine all year long.
Results.Title: Great features.

Results.ReviewText: Big cooking space for a small grill- really like the tank scale
Results.Title: great grill

Results.ReviewText: I always had charcoal grills in the past but I wanted something cleaner that charcoal and easier to light.  The Weber Spirit e-210 was perfect for my wife and I.  It even does the job when a dozen kids and grandkids come over!
Results.Title: Perfect fit for my family

Results.ReviewText: I went all of last year using my "portable Weber Grill" that I have had forever, because my full size four burner (not Weber) grill finally bit the dust after 7 years. My wife surprised me and bought me the Spirit E-210 and although it has only been a couple of weeks I am very impressed with the ease of use, functionality, and quality of materials at a reasonable price.  Let's hope that my perceptions of the quality hold up over time, but nevertheless it is a nice size, heats up quick, holds the heat, and looks good too.  I purchased the Griddle separately (which I felt was a bit expensive), but it has been a great addition. Overall, very happy with it.
Results.Title: High Quality Materials.

Results.ReviewText: Have been please with the performance of this grill.  Lights easily and gets hot enough to char steaks
Results.Title: Seems like a high quality grill

Results.Title: Great little grill

Results.ReviewText: I love my Spirit E210. It heats up fast. I love the features and that it doesn’t take much space in my patio. The butane tank sits on the floor so you have to remove it if you need to wheel it around which is an issue for a petite person like myself.

Results.Title: What a difference!

Results.ReviewText: Bought this grill a month ago. Have used to cook burgers, brats, bone-in ribeyes (tomahawk) and could not be more pleased with grill performance. Reaches high temperature (~600 degrees) with both burners on high and lid closed. Great design for catching drippings and debris. Easy to clean. I think it will last a long time as long as it is kept clean and protected from the elements (covered). I like the small footprint with side tables down. Takes up very little room on patio.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Bought this to replace an old different brand. I love the compact size, fold down shelfs, door that covers propane tank, and the propane gauge. Great size for us.
Results.Title: Love it

Results.ReviewText: we purchased this a few weeks ago and so enjoy that it is super easy to clean, easy to use and it the right size etc. for our deck.  Love this BBQ very good quality

Results.ReviewText: So happy with this grill. Really enjoy cooking on it.

Results.ReviewText: I have been grilling on Weber kettles for 30 years. I own 3. When I remarried10 years ago my Wife had an el-cheapo gas grill. I used it on week days for quick burgers and brats. I get charcoal quality grilled results without the 40 minute charcoal lighting ritual and the post cook clean out. I'll never give up my kettles, but I'll never be without the easy use of a weber gas grill.

Results.ReviewText: Love this, Best grill I ever owned! Gift for Fathers Day!

Results.Title: Works really well!

46110001.Name: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
